review_challenges.result_blind_motivation: The rule is based only on persisted acquisition completeness evidence. No candidate fill, P&L, return, rank, or gate existed or informed it.
review_challenges.post_hoc_discretion: The full cross-section, thresholds, fixed periods, rolling window, quote grid, chronology, and failure actions are fingerprinted and caller-non-overridable.
review_challenges.whole_session_economic_meaning: Excluding the full session preserves the simultaneous cross-sectional rank universe. It reduces the sample but does not reinterpret a missing symbol as an investable signal.
review_challenges.symbol_omission_and_ranking: No symbol-level omission is allowed. Every eligible session requires all twelve ranked ETFs plus SPY, so the ranking denominator and tie rule remain unchanged.
review_challenges.selection_bias: The report measures period, rolling, same-symbol, contiguous, month, clock, and early-close concentration before returns. Any machine ceiling failure is terminal and cannot be waived.
review_challenges.maximum_loss: One excluded trade session and one percent per fixed period, one incomplete or same-symbol-incomplete session per rolling twenty, one contiguous incomplete session, and zero required-context loss are restrictive rather than permissive for the known evidence.
review_challenges.quote_conservatism: Every symbol in every one of 657 windows requires at least 57 of 60 eligible causal observations. A failed or absent window fails calibration; no interpolation, compensation, or cost fallback exists.
review_challenges.controlled_periods: The same disposition applies to future Controlled A and B without access to either block. Later authorities must freeze reviewed calendar tables inside the unchanged block dates and may not alter this rule.
review_challenges.different_source: A prospectively reviewed different source is scientifically cleaner than raising thresholds to admit the clustered MDY-only failures.
